fields.help: IP address to bind the NetFlow UDP listener (use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)
fields.label: NetFlow Bind Host

fields.help: UDP port for NetFlow v5/v9/IPFIX datagrams (default 2055)
fields.label: NetFlow Bind Port

fields.help: Enable UDP NetFlow/IPFIX listener and flow ingestion
fields.label: Enable NetFlow Listener

fields.help: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs allowed to send flows (e.g. your router). Empty accepts any sender — recommended to set.
fields.label: Allowed NetFlow Exporters

fields.help: Comma-separated CIDR ranges that are considered internal (e.g. 192.168.0.0/16,10.0.0.0/8)
fields.label: Internal Networks

fields.help: Time window in seconds for port-scan detection
fields.label: Port Scan Window (s)

fields.help: Number of distinct ports contacted within the window to trigger a port-scan alert
fields.label: Port Scan Threshold

fields.help: Bytes sent outbound to trigger a high-egress alert
fields.label: High Egress Threshold (bytes)

fields.help: Periodically ping, port-scan and banner-grab internal hosts (Home Assistant's own addresses are always skipped). Off by default: scanning can trip other intrusion detection and upset fragile IoT devices.
fields.label: Enable Scanner

fields.help: Seconds between active scan cycles
fields.label: Scan Interval (s)

fields.help: Ports to scan (ranges and commas allowed, e.g. 22,80,443,8080-8090)
fields.label: Scan Ports

fields.help: Comma-separated IPs to exclude from active scanning
fields.label: Scan Exceptions

fields.help: Resolve hostnames for external IPs and check them against blacklists
fields.label: Enable DNS Resolution

fields.help: Comma or newline-separated HTTPS URLs of threat-intel blocklists to download
fields.label: Blacklist URLs

fields.help: Run a DNS proxy that logs and optionally blocks queries
fields.label: Enable DNS Proxy

fields.help: Listener bind address for DNS proxy (recommended: 127.0.0.1 or a specific LAN IP)
fields.label: DNS Proxy Bind Host

fields.help: UDP/TCP port for the DNS proxy listener (default 53 — requires root/CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE)
fields.label: DNS Proxy Port

fields.help: Upstream DNS resolver IP (e.g. 1.1.1.1); several may be comma-separated
fields.label: Upstream DNS Server

fields.help: How many hours to keep DNS query log entries (0 = until the 10,000-entry cap)
fields.label: DNS Log Retention (h)

fields.help: Write warning logs for each blocked DNS query (disabled by default to reduce log noise)
fields.label: Warn Logs for Blocked Domains

fields.help: Comma or newline-separated category names to block (e.g. ads,malware,tracking)
fields.label: Blocked DNS Categories

fields.help: Local DNS overrides, one per line: hostname=IP (e.g. myhost.local=192.168.1.5)
fields.label: DNS Local Overrides

fields.help: Look up country and network owner of contacted public IPs at ipwho.is. Off by default: every public IP your devices contact is sent to that third-party service.
fields.label: IP Geolocation (ipwho.is)

fields.help: Optional VirusTotal API key for external IP reputation lookup
fields.label: VirusTotal API Key

fields.help: Optional AbuseIPDB API key for external IP reputation lookup
fields.label: AbuseIPDB API Key

fields.help: Minimum abuse confidence score (0-100) to flag an IP as suspicious
fields.label: Threat Score Threshold (%)

fields.help: Max VirusTotal API lookups per day
fields.label: VirusTotal Daily Budget

fields.help: Max AbuseIPDB API lookups per day
fields.label: AbuseIPDB Daily Budget

fields.help: Minutes before re-querying enrichment APIs for a known IP
fields.label: Enrichment Cache TTL (min)

fields.help: Hours to retain clean external IPs in the dashboard
fields.label: External IP Retention (h)

fields.help: Hours to retain suspicious IPs
fields.label: Suspicious IP Retention (h)

fields.help: Hours to retain malicious IPs
fields.label: Malicious IP Retention (h)

fields.help: Optional free key from nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key. Speeds CVE downloads up about 10x (0.6 s instead of 6.5 s between requests).
fields.label: NVD API Key

fields.help: NVD CVE API endpoint URL (HTTPS)
fields.label: NVD API URL

fields.help: Hours before refreshing the NVD CVE cache
fields.label: NVD Cache TTL (h)

fields.help: Only show CVEs published on or after this year
fields.label: CVE Min Year

fields.help: Comma-separated product keywords to pre-fetch from NVD (e.g. OpenSSH,nginx,Samba)
fields.label: NVD Keywords

fields.help: Enable behavioural baseline learning and anomaly detection
fields.label: Enable Baseline

fields.help: Hours of traffic to observe before the baseline is considered trained
fields.label: Training Duration (h)

fields.help: Minimum number of flow observations before treating a pattern as normal
fields.label: Min Observations

fields.help: How many times the baseline egress a device must exceed before it is flagged
fields.label: Egress Anomaly Multiplier

fields.help: When enabled, only Home Assistant admin users can see the Security Assistant sidebar panel and read its data. Changing data always requires an admin.
fields.label: Sidebar panel requires admin

fields.help: How many top entries to show in statistics charts
fields.label: Statistics Top N

fields.help: Accept Suricata EVE JSON alerts over TCP from suricata_pusher.py
fields.label: Enable Suricata Listener

fields.help: IP address to bind the TCP listener (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces)
fields.label: Listener Bind Host

fields.help: TCP port for the Suricata pusher to connect to (default 6343)
fields.label: Listener TCP Port

fields.help: Shared secret the pusher must send first (suricata_pusher.py --token or HSA_SURICATA_TOKEN). Strongly recommended.

fields.help: Comma-separated IPs or CIDRs allowed to connect (e.g. the Suricata host). Empty accepts any source.
fields.label: Allowed Pusher Sources

fields.help: Hours to keep Suricata alert log entries (0 = until the 10,000-entry cap)
fields.label: Alert Log Retention (h)
